AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE TouchArea
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
    INSERT {
        // WeRead hot-review popup — the ONLY QML this project injects
        // now. The fullscreen QML reader that used to live here is
        // deprecated (docs/design.md §"已废弃：全屏 QML 阅读器"):
        // reading happens in xochitl's own PDF reader on documents the
        // daemon generates, so this patch shrank from a fullscreen
        // surface back down to rm-agent's proven popup size.
        //
        // NOTE: every comment must live inside this INSERT block — the
        // .qmd grammar rejects top-level `//` lines (confirmed on
        // device; fails safe but silent).
        //
        // This QML runs INSIDE xochitl's process. Always validate with
        // `xovi/debug` in the foreground before making it persistent.
        //
        // Two interactions:
        //  1. Four-finger tap -> touch `generate`, show progress from
        //     gen.txt while the daemon builds/refreshes the PDF.
        //  2. Tap on a circled marker (①..⑳ burned into the PDF) ->
        //     hit-test against layout.json's marker boxes, touch
        //     `ask_<chapterUid>_<range>_<nonce>`, poll reviews.txt,
        //     show the popup. Taps that miss every marker pass through
        //     untouched (mouse.accepted = false), so page turns behave
        //     exactly as before on pages without markers.
        //
        // ── ON-DEVICE TODO (the one open question of this design) ──
        // Marker hit-testing needs the CURRENT PDF PAGE (0-based) and
        // ideally the view transform (zoom/pan). Both almost certainly
        // exist somewhere on this documentview QML context; the names
        // must be found on a real device by dumping the documentview/
        // QML via qt-resource-rebuilder and reading what SceneView /
        // its parents expose (or logging parent-chain property names
        // from here). Until then `weReadCurrentPage()` returns -1 and
        // marker taps are DISABLED — reading and generation work, the
        // popup doesn't fire. Wire it up by replacing the body of
        // weReadCurrentPage() below. v1 also assumes an unzoomed page
        // (3:4 PDF fills the 3:4 screen 1:1); zoom support needs the
        // transform from the same dump.

        TouchAreaClickFilter {
            id: weReadGenerateFilter
            palmAreaThreshold: touchArea.tapPalmThreshold
            enabled: !touchArea.panAndZoomOnly
            fingers: 4
            onClick: {
                weReadStatus.lastSeq = weReadIpc.readSeq("gen.txt");
                weReadStatus.message = "正在生成…";
                weReadStatus.visible = true;
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/generate"]);
                weReadGenPoller.start();
            }
        }

        CommandExecutor {
            id: weReadCmd
        }

        FontLoader {
            id: weReadFont
            source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/NotoSansSC.ttf"
        }

        Item {
            id: weReadIpc
            visible: false
            property var layoutData: null

            function readFile(name) {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/" + name, false);
                    xhr.send();
                    return xhr.responseText || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            function readSeq(name) {
                var n = parseInt(readFile(name).split("\n")[0]);
                return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
            }

            function loadLayout() {
                var raw = readFile("layout.json");
                if (!raw) { layoutData = null; return; }
                try { layoutData = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { layoutData = null; }
            }

            // ON-DEVICE TODO (see header comment): return the 0-based
            // page of the PDF currently on screen, or -1 when unknown.
            function currentPage() {
                return -1;
            }

            // Nearest marker on `page` whose expanded box contains the
            // normalized tap point, or null.
            function hitMarker(page, nx, ny) {
                if (!layoutData || !layoutData.markers) return null;
                var sx = 44.0 / 702.0 / 2.0, sy = 44.0 / 936.0 / 2.0;
                var best = null, bestDist = 1e9;
                for (var i = 0; i < layoutData.markers.length; i++) {
                    var m = layoutData.markers[i];
                    if (m.page !== page) continue;
                    if (nx < m.x0 - sx || nx > m.x1 + sx || ny < m.y0 - sy || ny > m.y1 + sy) continue;
                    var d = Math.abs(nx - (m.x0 + m.x1) / 2) + Math.abs(ny - (m.y0 + m.y1) / 2);
                    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = m; }
                }
                return best;
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: weReadMarkerTap
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 900
            propagateComposedEvents: true
            visible: !weReadPopup.visible
            onPressed: (mouse) => {
                var page = weReadIpc.currentPage();
                if (page < 0) { mouse.accepted = false; return; }
                if (!weReadIpc.layoutData) weReadIpc.loadLayout();
                var m = weReadIpc.hitMarker(page, mouse.x / width, mouse.y / height);
                if (!m) { mouse.accepted = false; return; }
                mouse.accepted = true;
                weReadPopup.quote = "";
                weReadPopup.reviewsText = "正在加载评论…";
                weReadPopup.visible = true;
                weReadPopup.lastSeq = weReadIpc.readSeq("reviews.txt");
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", [
                    "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/ask_" + m.chapter_uid + "_" + m.range + "_" + Date.now()
                ]);
                weReadReviewPoller.start();
            }
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: weReadStatus
            visible: false
            z: 1500
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 2
            radius: 6
            width: Math.min(parent.width * 0.7, 620)
            height: weReadStatusText.implicitHeight + 40
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            y: 24
            property int lastSeq: 0
            property string message: ""

            Text {
                id: weReadStatusText
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: parent.width - 40
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 24
                color: "black"
                text: weReadStatus.message
            }

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: { weReadStatus.visible = false; weReadGenPoller.stop(); }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadGenPoller
            interval: 500
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = weReadIpc.readFile("gen.txt");
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadStatus.lastSeq) {
                    weReadStatus.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    weReadStatus.message = lines.length > 2 ? lines.slice(2).join(" ") : "";
                    if (status === "working") { elapsedMs = 0; return; }
                    weReadIpc.loadLayout();
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    weReadStatusHide.restart();
                    return;
                }
                // A whole book takes a while; only give up after 30 min.
                if (elapsedMs > 1800000) {
                    weReadStatus.message = "(超时，看看 daemon 日志)";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadStatusHide
            interval: 8000
            onTriggered: weReadStatus.visible = false
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: weReadPopup
            visible: false
            z: 1500
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 2
            radius: 8
            width: Math.min(parent.width * 0.8, 900)
            height: Math.min(parent.height * 0.6, 1100)
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            property int lastSeq: 0
            property string quote: ""
            property string reviewsText: ""

            Text {
                id: weReadQuote
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 24
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.leftMargin: 28
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.rightMargin: 28
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                maximumLineCount: 3
                elide: Text.ElideRight
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 26
                font.bold: true
                color: "black"
                visible: text.length > 0
                text: weReadPopup.quote
            }

            Flickable {
                anchors.top: weReadQuote.visible ? weReadQuote.bottom : parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 20
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.bottomMargin: 24
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.leftMargin: 28
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.rightMargin: 28
                contentHeight: weReadReviews.implicitHeight
                clip: true

                Text {
                    id: weReadReviews
                    width: parent.width
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    font.family: weReadFont.name
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    lineHeight: 1.3
                    color: "black"
                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                    text: weReadPopup.reviewsText
                }
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: weReadPopupDismiss
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 1400
            visible: weReadPopup.visible
            onClicked: {
                weReadPopup.visible = false;
                weReadReviewPoller.stop();
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadReviewPoller
            interval: 300
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = weReadIpc.readFile("reviews.txt");
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadPopup.lastSeq) {
                    weReadPopup.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    if (status === "ok") {
                        weReadPopup.quote = lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "";
                        var total = lines.length > 3 ? lines[3] : "0";
                        var body = "";
                        for (var i = 4; i < lines.length; i++) {
                            if (!lines[i]) continue;
                            var tab = lines[i].indexOf("\t");
                            var author = tab >= 0 ? lines[i].substring(0, tab) : "";
                            var content = tab >= 0 ? lines[i].substring(tab + 1) : lines[i];
                            body += (body ? "\n\n" : "") + author + "：" + content;
                        }
                        weReadPopup.reviewsText = (total + " 条想法\n\n") + (body || "（还没有想法）");
                    } else {
                        weReadPopup.reviewsText = lines.length > 2 ? lines.slice(2).join(" ") : "(出错)";
                    }
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                if (elapsedMs > 20000) {
                    weReadPopup.reviewsText = "(超时，请重试)";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
